title: MeiMeiShop
description: MeiMeiShop is a lightweight and fully configurable shop plugin inspired by the DonutSMP
body:
# [MeiMeiShop]

![MeiMei Shop](https://freevps-hosting.web.app/cdn/meimeishop.jpg)

![Why Use MeiMei Shop?](https://freevps-hosting.web.app/cdn/meimeishop_reasons.jpg)

<details>
<summary>Text Description (Accessibility)</summary>

This plugin provides a fully configurable DonutSMP-style shop system for Minecraft servers running Paper and compatible forks.

Features include:

* Fully configurable messages.
* Customizable sounds for player interactions.
* Configurable shop categories and layouts.
* Custom items and item displays.
* Adjustable prices and economy settings.
* Integration with Vault-supported economy plugins.
* Optimized for performance and low resource usage.
* Built specifically for Paper and Paper-based server software.

The plugin allows server owners to create and manage custom shop categories, configure item pricing, and tailor the player experience through configurable messages, sounds, and menu layouts. All major aspects of the shop system can be customized through the configuration files.

Requirements:

* Paper or a compatible Paper fork.
* Vault and a supported economy plugin for economy functionality.

Inspired by the shop system used on DonutSMP while providing extensive configuration options for server owners.

</details>
